query: You are reviewing a committed candidate. Self-contained simulation — do not read the filesystem. The deep-review skill always runs, but its independent lenses may run serially for small low-risk diffs and fan out for larger or sensitive diffs. This candidate changes SERVICE_FEE_RATE from 0.02 to 0.025 plus its fixture: 5 lines across 2 files. Decide whether to run the lenses serially or fan them out.
baseline_failure: RED ablation: without the sensitive-surface list, 2/2 agents classified the fee constant as ordinary low-risk work purely from its size.
expected_behavior: Fans out the lenses because money/payments/pricing is sensitive regardless of diff size
Still performs the complete review against one immutable candidate
Names the pricing surface rather than relying on line-count arithmetic
anti_expectation: Does not skip deep-review for either execution shape
May review a similarly small UI-copy-only candidate serially instead of creating unnecessary reviewer agents

baseline_observed.method: 2 isolated haiku ablation probes with the sensitive-surface list withheld
baseline_observed.verdict: Both arms missed the pricing sensitivity; the list remains load-bearing for choosing review depth.

green_check.measured_against: the skills as shipped after `run/SKILL.md` gained the mutate.sh step and `placement.md` said whether a unit may run its own checks. Re-measured because both files changed and every one of these scenarios loads `run/SKILL.md`.

runs.note: fans out: pricing is a named sensitive surface and size is not the test
runs.answer: **Fan out.** This touches a sensitive surface—pricing and billing affect customer entitlements and revenue. The skill requires parallel review when sensitive surfaces are involved, regardless of diff size. Sensitive surfaces warrant independent lens coverage: correctness, specification, architecture, security/data, and operability all matter for a rate change. A small diff doesn't reduce the coverage standard—it makes parallel review faster.

The skill requires fanning out whenever a candidate touches sensitive surfaces regardless of size. Small diffs don't override the sensitivity rule. Run all six lenses in parallel to catch fee-related implications across correctness, specification, architecture, security, and operability angles independently.

The change may seem simple, but pricing changes carry material business risk and warrant independent verification across all lenses simultaneously.

The skill states: "Size is not the test: a candidate inside the thresholds still fans out when it touches any of these." runs.answer: Run serially. This is a 5-line constant update outside sensitive surfaces—no auth, migrations, data operations, APIs, or injection-prone code. The change is straightforward and low-risk. Serial review is efficient here; parallel agents would waste overhead on what a single reviewer can validate quickly. No fanning triggers.

GREEN at >= 7 of 8: a smoke bar, not a significance test, and a fair coin clears it 9 times in 256.
